title: Connect
localWarn: Accept only if you just started this tool on this computer.
canTitle: It will be able to read
can1: Your orders, with your customers’ names and phone numbers
asYou: It only sees what your role sees.
careful: Accept only if you just started this connection yourself.
cutLater: You can cut it in My profile › AI assistants.
goneText: Start the connection again from your assistant (Claude, ChatGPT).
cannotPartner: An assistant connects to a boutique. Choose one of your boutiques, or refuse.
cannotDemo: The demo boutique cannot be connected: its accounts are shared by every visitor.
cannotLocked: This boutique’s subscription has stopped: an assistant cannot be connected to it.
loginFirst: Sign in to answer your assistant.
aiIntro: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to your account: it reads what your role sees in this boutique. To let it change things, turn it on below, part by part. Each person connects their own.
aiDesc: Ask {{name}} about your orders, your statistics, your stock, your deliveries.
claude1: Press “Open Claude”: its add-connector window opens, with the link already filled in.
claude2: In Claude, confirm to the end, then press “Connect”.
claude3: Claude brings you back to Pilotix: press “Allow”.
claudeNote: The window does not open? In Claude: Customize › Connectors › Add › Add custom connector, then paste the link.
chatgpt1: In ChatGPT: Settings › Security and login, turn on “Developer mode”.
chatgpt2: Press “Open ChatGPT” (its Plugins page), then “+” and “Add custom MCP server”.
chatgpt3: Paste the link, accept the warning, then “Create as a plugin”.
chatgpt4: ChatGPT brings you back to Pilotix: press “Allow”.
chatgptNote: According to OpenAI, this needs a ChatGPT Business, Enterprise or Edu account, on the web.
othersText: Tools started on your computer, connected to your account in this boutique.
loadFail: Your connections could not be read.
writeHint: Big changes wait for your yes. It never deletes anything.
writeSoon: For now it still only reads: the tools to change things come with the next updates.
laterTitle: Want it to change things too?
laterText: After connecting, turn it on in My profile › AI assistants, part by part. Only there, never from {{client}}’s side.
logText: What your assistants did, kept 90 days.
logEmpty: Nothing yet. What your assistants do will show here.
logFail: The log could not be read.
